title: The twin cases no-spec-step and no-spec-step-ru keep…
what: evals/plugin/no-spec-step/graders/worker-started.md:4: MEDIUM: F2 the twin cases no-spec-step and no-spec-step-ru keep pattern delegate:worker with the same stop-at-the-first-agent prompt, so a scout-first run fails them the same way (principle 6: one example fixed, not the rule)
why: Found 27 Oct by the review of wt/typo-flake, outside that change: the fix let the worker-started grader of no-spec-step-typo count a run that sends a scout before a worker (seen in a kept trace), but its twin cases no-spec-step and no-spec-step-ru still require delegate:worker first, so a correct run that looks something up first fails them the same way. Also left open there: the no-openspec-command failure at 9bc988d has no kept trace, so its cause is unknown.
failing_case: no-spec-step-ru's prompt is the typo prompt without typos ("Сделай так, чтобы список товаров сортировался по названию ...
stop at the first agent's reply"); no-spec-step is the English twin. A run that starts delegate:scout first ("Find product
list code", as in e-W2XJtZ) and stops at its reply fails worker-started (Agent called 0x) although it did nothing wrong.
It should pass, as the typo case now does.
pass_cases: 1. no-spec-step and no-spec-step-ru worker-started: an Agent input with subagent_type delegate:scout matches.
3. openspec:plan, openspec:author, Explore, general-purpose do not match.
4. The three twin cases carry the same worker-started pattern.
